meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 在 macOS 菜单栏添加一个螺栓图标，用绿点/红点显示 NanoClaw 是否在运行，并提供启动、停止、重启操作。安装后图标常驻菜单栏，点击可查看状态和控制服务。
howto.when: 在 macOS 上，当用户要求为 NanoClaw 添加菜单栏状态图标时触发。若系统缺少 Xcode Command Line Tools，会先提示安装。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 添加菜单栏状态图标。
say.note: 会开始编译并安装状态栏程序。

say.text: 检查 NanoClaw 的菜单栏状态是否正常。
say.note: 会验证服务是否在运行。

say.text: 移除 NanoClaw 的菜单栏状态图标。

howto.what_en: Adds a persistent bolt icon to the macOS menu bar with a green/red dot showing whether NanoClaw is running, plus Start, Stop, and Restart controls.
howto.when_en: Triggers on macOS when the user asks to add a menu bar status icon for NanoClaw. If Xcode Command Line Tools are missing, it prompts to install them first.

say_en.text: Add a menu bar status icon for NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Starts compiling and installing the status bar app.

say_en.text: Check if NanoClaw's menu bar status is running.
say_en.note: Verifies whether the service is active.

say_en.text: Remove NanoClaw's menu bar status icon.
say_en.note: Runs the uninstall steps from REMOVE.md.
